mapper.select: SELECT id,import_type,batch_id,configuration::text AS configuration,source_file_id,status,created_by,confirmed_by, created_at,confirmed_at,cancelled_at,expires_at,confirmed_result::text AS confirmed_result,row_version FROM public.import_jobs WHERE id=#{id} AND batch_id=#{batchId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,job_id,row_number,normalized_payload::text AS normalized_payload,preview_metadata::text AS preview_metadata, committed_resource_type,committed_resource_id,created_at FROM public.import_rows WHERE job_id=#{jobId} ORDER BY row_number
mapper.update: UPDATE public.import_jobs SET row_version=row_version+1,configuration=CAST(#{job.configuration} AS jsonb),status=#{job.status}, confirmed_by=#{job.confirmedBy},confirmed_at=#{job.confirmedAt},cancelled_at=#{job.cancelledAt}, confirmed_result=CAST(#{job.confirmedResult} AS jsonb) WHERE id=#{job.id} AND batch_id=#{job.batchId} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.import_rows (id,job_id,row_number,normalized_payload,preview_metadata,committed_resource_type,committed_resource_id,created_at) VALUES (#{r.id},#{r.jobId},#{r.rowNumber},CAST(#{r.normalizedPayload} AS jsonb),CAST(#{r.previewMetadata} AS jsonb), #{r.committedResourceType},#{r.committedResourceId},#{r.createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.import_rows r SET preview_metadata=v.preview_metadata,committed_resource_type=v.resource_type,committed_resource_id=v.resource_id FROM (VALUES (CAST(#{r.id} AS uuid),CAST(#{r.jobId} AS uuid),CAST(#{r.previewMetadata} AS jsonb),CAST(#{r.committedResourceType} AS text),CAST(#{r.committedResourceId} AS uuid)) ) AS v(id,job_id,preview_metadata,resource_type,resource_id) WHERE r.id=v.id AND r.job_id=v.job_id
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.import_jobs j WHERE j.batch_id=#{batchId} AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(j.configuration->'selectedBatchDayIds') selected(id) WHERE selected.id IN CAST(#{id} AS text)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.import_rows r WHERE r.job_id=j.id AND r.preview_metadata->>'batchDayId' IN CAST(#{id} AS text))))
